sources.quote: Pioneer Pioneer Pioneer is a startup accelerator for ambitious outsiders. We've funded 150+ companies with 300+ founders in 50+ countries. We stopped making new investments in 2024. Our companies are worth over $2B in aggregate. They've gone on to raise from Sequoia, a16z, General Catalyst, Y Combinator, Khosla Ventures, and many more. Some of our investments include: Railway (TQ Ventures, Redpoint) Slash (Ribbit, Goodwater, NEA) Roboflow (GV, Craft) E2B (Insight, Decibel) TextQL (DCM, Neo) Pioneer was founded by Rishi Narang and Daniel Gross in 2018, and is backed by Stripe and Marc Andreessen. Our founders have been mentored by an incredible network of advisors & speakers including: Christina Cacioppo , Co-founder & CEO of Vanta David Hsu , Co-founder & CEO of Retool Dylan Field , Co-founder & CEO of Figma Guillermo Rauch , Co-founder & CEO of Vercel Immad Akhund , Co-founder & CEO of Mercury Jeff Weinstein , Product Lead at Stripe John Collison , Co-founder & President of Stripe Laura Behrens Wu , Co-founder & CEO of Shippo Laura Deming , Partner at age1 Olof Mathé , Co-founder & CEO of Mixmax Patrick Collison , Co-founder & CEO of Stripe Sriram Krishnan , Partner at a16z And dozens of other founders, investors, and operators. “Pioneer is the biggest ramp in terms of changing my life's trajectory.
